items.title: Gucci Welcomes the Holidays with Mariah Carey in a Festive New Campaign
items.summary: Singapore-based NYLON covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign, directed by Harmony Korine, starring Mariah Carey in a hotel transformed for the holidays set to her song 'All I Want for Christmas Is You.' Carey models pieces from the new Butterfly collection; the piece runs down the gift edit of bags, boots and accessories.

items.title: Gucci Gift แคมเปญใหม่ต้อนรับเทศกาลแห่งการเฉลิมฉลอง
items.summary: Esquire Thailand's localized coverage of the Gucci Gift holiday campaign, describing the gifting edit (bags, shoes, accessories) and the brand's playful festive tone, tied to the global Mariah Carey campaign launch earlier in the week.

items.title: Gucci เปิดตัวแคมเปญต้อนรับเทศกาลแห่งความสุขช่วงปลายปี ที่ได้ Mariah Carey มารับบทแสดงนำ
items.summary: Harper's Bazaar Thailand's write-up of the Gucci Holiday 2026 campaign starring Mariah Carey, highlighting the Butterfly collection's tie-in to her 1997 album and the brand's seasonal gifting assortment.

items.title: Gulf Kanawut's brand collaborations in 2026: Gucci, Onitsuka Tiger, Sulwhasoo and more
items.summary: Tatler Asia catalogues Thai actor Gulf Kanawut's 2026 brand ties, including his ongoing Gucci collaboration, as part of the house's continued regional-ambassador presence through fashion-week appearances and events across Asia and Europe.

items.title: Kering Q3 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Organic Sales Down 6 Percent
items.summary: WWD's earnings report notes Kering Q3 2026 revenue flat at EUR3.35bn as Gucci organic sales fell 6%; Asia Pacific retail sales fell 8% comparable, with China the principal source of weakness while South Korea showed continued momentum. Carried for its direct relevance to current APAC/SEA retail-sentiment context; the one hard critical/business-risk data point this run's critical-angle searches surfaced for the region.

search_notes.freshness: The dominant live SEA-relevant story on 2026-11-04 is the global Gucci Holiday 2026 / Mariah Carey campaign (published 2026-11-02/03), independently localized by three SEA outlets (NYLON Singapore, Esquire Thailand, Harper's Bazaar Thailand) -- this is today's primary SEA signal. Beyond that, genuinely fresh (within 72h-7d) SEA-specific Gucci news was scarce; two slightly older items (Tatler Asia ambassador roundup, WWD Kering Q3 earnings) were retained because they fall within the 14-day ceiling and carry binding analytical relevance (ongoing regional ambassador strategy; the only hard APAC business-risk data point found). No item older than 14 days was admitted. Several leads were checked and explicitly rejected for exceeding the 14-day ceiling, including a Billkin/Marina Bay Sands Threads fan post (2025-09-24), a PP Krit Milan ambassador announcement (2026-09-18/19), an X trending topic on PP Krit at Milan (2026-09-26), a Da Nang Gucci/Chanel counterfeit-raid story (verified publish date 2024-11-04, not 2026), and an Indonesian resale-price-decline article (Liputan6, 2024-11-15).
search_notes.anti_bias: Critical-angle searches ran in English, Thai, Indonesian and Vietnamese (price hike/backlash, resale price drop, quality complaints, boycott, 'overrated/lost its way', counterfeit enforcement, store closures). They did not run dry globally -- the Kering Q3 2026 earnings miss (Gucci organic sales -6%, APAC retail -8%) surfaced and is included as item 005 -- but for SEA specifically almost all other critical-angle hits were either stale (2024-dated Vietnam counterfeit raids and Indonesia resale-price stories, both recurring search results that pre-date the window) or unverifiable (a Thai-language search surfaced a reported viral story about a dismissed Gucci retail employee via headline snippets on khaosod.co.th and thethaiger.com, but a 2026 publish date could not be confirmed and it was not independently fetched, so it was excluded rather than guessed at). Net effect: this SEA pool is activation-skewed (3 of 5 items are the same holiday-campaign story localized three ways) with only one genuine negative/risk signal -- flagged explicitly rather than padded with unverifiable critical items.
search_notes.channel_mix_gap: SNS and community coverage for SEA came back dry this run. Priority-A/B community sources (Pantip, Kaskus, Lowyat Forum, HardwareZone Forums, Webtretho) were site-searched directly in-language; all returned only old evergreen threads (product authentication questions, brand-history posts, slang usage of the word 'gucci') with no freshly dated posts. Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and Threads searches for SEA-specific Gucci content surfaced only month-plus-old ambassador event material, already past the 14-day ceiling. Zero sns/community items met the admission bar this run -- stated here rather than padded with stale or fabricated items; this is a genuine gap, not an oversight.
